question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Condemn
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Condemn"** means to express strong disapproval of something, typically in public; to censure. (निंदा करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The government was quick to** condemn** the violence in the city.
 
 
 
• **"Denounce"** refers to publicly declaring something to be wrong or evil; to criticize harshly and publicly. (निंदा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The activist **denounced** the corrupt practices of the officials.
 
 

Therefore, the correct synonym of **Condemn** is **Denounce**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Uphold** (बनाए रखना): To support or maintain something.

 
 
• **Example:** The judge** upheld** the decision of the lower court.
 
 
 
• **Elevate** (ऊँचा उठाना): To raise or lift something up.
 
 
• **Example:** The new policy aims to** elevate** the standard of living for the poor.
 
 
 
• **Tolerate** (सहन करना): To allow the existence, occurrence, or practice of something that one does not necessarily like or agree with.
 
 
• **Example:** She could no longer **tolerate** the noise from the construction site.
